record.name: Overload

universal_access.description: Electronic systems overload and sabotage technology

record.narrative: You force a catastrophic power surge through electronic systems, circuits overloading beyond safety limits until they detonate in showers of sparks and molten components. The power manifests as lights flickering wildly, warning alarms screaming, then explosive failure as technology destroys itself from within.
record.flavor_text: "Everything has a breaking point. I just find it faster." - Slicer

manifestation.description: interfacing with target system or transmitting surge signal

base_effect.description: You overload an electronic device or droid, causing it to malfunction and potentially explode.

mechanics.notes: Target makes Constitution save or suffers catastrophic failure
Deal 3d6 lightning damage on failed save
Systems disabled for 1 minute on failed save

class_synergies.narrative: The Engineer's electronics expertise makes their Overload surgical sabotage. They know exactly which systems to overload for maximum effect—power cores for explosions, memory banks for data destruction, or weapons systems for tactical disarmament.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Engineers choose overload type and deal +1d6 lightning damage.

species_synergies.narrative: Human hacking intuition transforms Overload into creative sabotage. They've used it to trigger false alarms, create diversions, even backdoor into systems through the chaos of controlled failure—finding opportunity in destruction.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Human Overload can chain to one connected electronic system.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Rebel Alliance has weaponized Overload for asymmetric warfare. Their slicers can trigger cascading failures through Imperial networks, one overload starting chain reactions that cripple entire facilities—digital sabotage amplified through systemic vulnerabilities.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Rebel Overload increases save DC by 2 (harder to resist).

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe warning lights flashing, systems screaming in protest, then catastrophic failure. Show sparks erupting, components melting, droids convulsing as their circuits fry. The overload should feel like technology betraying itself, self-destruction through forced limits.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Overload deals 3d6 lightning damage and disables electronic targets on failed save. Costs 1 Tech Point, devastating against droids and electronic systems. The 30-foot range is safe, the disable effect creates tactical advantages. Useless against purely organic enemies.
narrative_hooks: An overload cascades through Imperial systems, causing base-wide blackout
A droid's catastrophic failure at a critical moment turns the battle
Overload backdoor grants unexpected access to enemy network

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of a droid or electronic system experiencing catastrophic overload. Electricity arcs across circuits, sparks erupting from overloaded components. Warning lights flash frantically, displays showing critical errors before explosive failure. The device convulses as it destroys itself from within, showing the devastating power of forced system failure.
